clips.title: The story
paras: Call of Earth is an introductory summons calling an initiate to attune with the spirits of the stone. Directed to Coldridge Valley, the traveler must seek out Teo Hammerstorm within the dwarven holdfast of Anvilmar.

For an initiate walking the path of the elements, the call of earth is the vital first communion. While elemental energies may already stir across the skin, learning to speak directly with stone establishes a steadfast balance. It teaches the spirit how to find immovable strength, setting firm footing beneath one's boots and within the spirit itself.

Initiates in the snowy reaches of Dun Morogh are directed into the shelter of Anvilmar, a massive holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will. Within this venerable redoubt in Coldridge Valley waits Teo Hammerstorm, who instructs fledgling shamans on how to heed the rumbling earth and begin their elemental duties.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: It's past time ye heeded the earth, brave adventurer. The elements already prickle in yer skin, but once ye speak with the stone, the ground itself'll set firm 'neath yer soles--and in yer soul.
Seek out Teo Hammerstorm, in Coldridge Valley. Ye'll find him within Anvilmar, a holdfast forged by hammer, fire, and will.

clips.title: Completion
paras: The land itself let me know ye were comin'! Aye, sometimes, the burnin' fire within us is enough to power us through the snow without even touchin' the ground!
